title: Consumer Loan Origination
summary: Business and systems analysis to automate consumer loan processing at Luminor Group.
challenge: The consumer loan process involved approximately 2 hours of processing.
contribution: Provided business and systems analysis for the design of an automated consumer loan process.
outcomes: Processing time reduced from approximately 2 hours to 3 minutes.
limitations: Outcome is self-reported in the LinkedIn profile; measurement method and period are not published.
